history.summary: A 1,381 sqft 9999-year-leasehold (effectively freehold) 4BR in D15 Marine Parade at $2.18M ($1,579 PSF), 420m from the new Marine Parade TE26 MRT. Strong location and tenure but no URA data and a missing build year leave the asset's age and condition unverified.
history.rating_rationale: The location is the headline: 420m (5-min walk) to the brand-new Marine Parade TEL station in coveted D15, with effectively-freehold 9999-yr tenure and a large 4BR at a reasonable $1,579 PSF and liquid $2.18M price. Strong arena elo (1438). But built_year is missing and there's zero URA appreciation/txn data — Marine Mansion is likely an older walk-up/boutique block, which raises maintenance, en-bloc-dependency and resale questions. The TEL catalyst is real and lifts it to the top of Neutral, but unverified age caps confidence.
red_flags: Missing build year — likely an older/dated development
No URA appreciation or transaction data
Probable small boutique block; en-bloc-dependent upside
catalysts: 420m to new Marine Parade TE26 MRT (TEL) — strong connectivity uplift
Prime D15 East Coast with deep buyer pool
9999-year tenure ~ freehold; large 4BR at $1,579 PSF is fair value
